meta.note: Requires n8n env: SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET (HMAC key, NEVER hardcode), SLACK_APPROVER_IDS (comma-separated Slack member IDs), SLACK_CHANNEL_ID (bot-invited channel). Reuses the Break Glass Shared Secret and GitHub PAT header-auth credentials; add a Slack Bot Token header-auth credential (Authorization: Bearer xoxb-...). Set N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false. Discord workflow is separate and untouched.
